terms_note: Ghana listings; apply on employer link.

endpoints.call: keep — assist for apply; the WP Job Manager job_listing RSS is a usable public feed
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. WordPress board with a public job_listing RSS feed; no developer API. robots.txt 6 rules; terms page exists (clauses not extracted).

search.note: WordPress post-type feed of job_listing posts (RSS 2.0, 10 per page). WordPress feeds take the site search as s and page with paged (https://wordpress.org/documentation/article/wordpress-feeds/); ?feed=job_feed answers 404 on this site. location and limit are not sent. title is 'Role at Employer'; description is the full post (content:encoded, HTML) and the WordPress post id is raw['post-id']. id is the posting permalink.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none'): the feed is public and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The feed has no per-item endpoint (each posting's url is an HTML page); search returns the whole record in raw.
not_offered.apply: No application endpoint: the feed only lists postings; candidates apply on each posting's url (employer page / e-mail).
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the only machine-readable interface is the public job feed.
